dossier.scp_unleashed.001_gate.title: The Gate Guardian
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_gate.caption: SCP-001 and SCP-001-1, photographed from the edge of the plain
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_gate.page.0.te: SCP-001 cannot be contained. The plain surrounding it is to be watched from a distance of no less than one kilometre.
No personnel, vehicle or aircraft is to approach SCP-001. Personnel who notice SCP-001-1 turning its head toward them are to withdraw at once and report to the site lead.
Several contained entities have resisted transport through the region. Their handlers are not to force the matter.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_gate.page.1.te: SCP-001 is a freestanding archway of pale stone, approximately thirty metres tall, standing alone at the centre of a barren plain. The archway joins no wall and no road.
Seen through the opening, a different place is visible: open grassland under a clear sky, with a single tree. The view does not match the plain behind the archway from any angle.
Nothing grows near SCP-001. The ground there is cracked and dry, and the wind carries dust and warmth regardless of season.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_gate.page.2.te: SCP-001-1 is a humanoid entity approximately twenty metres tall, clad in pale armour, bearing six wings and a blade of comparable length. The entity and its blade are wreathed in fire that consumes no fuel.
SCP-001-1 holds its place before the archway and has never been observed to leave it. It does not speak.
Every attempt to reach the archway has failed. %rDetails of these attempts are restricted to Level 5 personnel.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_gate.page.3.te: Audio recovered from the helmet camera of a field agent sent to survey the plain.
Agent: It turned. It's looking straight at me and I'm nowhere near it.
Agent: There are words. I can see them, right in front of me. It's telling me to-
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_gate.page.4.te: SCP-001-1 does not hunt, and it does not pursue. It keeps the gate. Whatever lies beyond the archway, it was not meant for us.
